content.navigationModuleTreatment: RGO navigation extends the one retained base system; local labels are in RGO-00 editorial package.
content.specialProjectionAdaptationScope: Routes/vaults, drilling, dome and final projection need separate output/adaptation estimates; hardware and output-channel counts remain unknown.
content.packageDefinition: One scoped production package per distinct proposed AV experience; one editorial package per hall. Not one package per exhibit, screen, station or language.

capacityScenario.note: Six joint participants are a design assumption, not six independent touch users. Prototype the controls and actual active roles. This check does not validate all halls, special installations, queues or a 4-hour park route.

reconciliation.formula: (152 − 12 unassigned common reserve) + (26 local RGO − 1 shared navigation) = 165 described LED surfaces
reconciliation.scopeNote: Other common programs and special projection/portrait/ceiling systems remain outside this count. Do not publish 152+26 or call 165 the complete equipment register.
reconciliation.installationNote: Nine halls, 45+ exhibit references, 16 new AV functional nodes and 26 local LED surfaces are different units. The AV nodes cannot yet be added to 80 territorial points as a complete installation count.

caveats: Only hall themes, listed exhibit/media functions and the nine program areas come from the working presentation. Counts, cabinet grids, packaging and three station copies are our proposal.
The proposed dimensions are cabinet dimensions, not a fit check. Mounts, safety zones, actual heights, sightlines and floor/ceiling loads need the real hall geometry.
LED does not provide touch capability by itself. Separate buttons, sensors, joysticks or non-display input tablets are proposed; their number, power and mass are unknown.
All LED maximums are published series upper bounds, not a confirmed supply passport. Maximums exclude controllers, computers, projectors, portraits, sound, light, effects and HVAC.
The 00–08 source numbering and exhibit numbers in parentheses are identifiers, not quantities of screens.
Projection surfaces are not assumed planar or rectangular. No area or hardware zero is entered for unresolved special systems.
The 240-minute full-park route already needs reallocation if the complete RGO visit is added; no RGO duration has been approved here.
A language or aspect-ratio version is an output/version of a package, not automatically a new story.

registration.controls: Column grid: u516,1020,1524,2028,3036 correspond to Z -62.067,-35.067,-8.067,18.933,72.933; v1300 corresponds to X1.316. CAD/source origin gives Y7.2.

limitations: 1120 м² — сумма программы залов, не площадь восстановленных контуров.
Тематические стены растрового плана не подтверждены отдельными помещениями в текущей 3D-модели.
45+ будущих экспонатов РГО в данном слое не смоделированы; их габариты и резервы неизвестны.
Монтажные системы, расчёт креплений, питание, углы обзора, доступность и эвакуация требуют отдельной проверки.
Сечения CAD на Y7.35/8.3/9.3 и существующие прокси дают ограниченную проверку кандидатов; это не доказательство монтажной пригодности.
Существующие экспонаты сохраняют координаты. При просмотре конфликтующего зала их можно показать полупрозрачными.
